the loafers add instant polish without being too formal, and the chocolate polo under the vest keeps the silhouette structured.","deliberate":[{"item":"#284·31","why":"I chose these straight trousers to create a clear vertical line from hips to hem, ensuring there is an even column without a step at the waist so the outfit reads sharp rather than boxy.","finding":"f-o1-3"},{"item":"#96·31","why":"I kept this bag in warm ginger because it echoes the scheme's accent and breaks the neutrality of the top and bottom, adding necessary interest while staying within the muted_complementary arc.","finding":"f-o1-5"}]},{"id":"o6","caption":"Soft work: chocolate blouse, black midi, ballet flats","pole":"tonal_column","items":["#57·12","#52·16","#340·32","#283·32","#157·10"],"day":"Perfect for an office environment requiring smart neatness; it defines the waist visually without needing a belt on this soft fabric blend.","finding":"f-o6-4"},{"item":"#157·10","why":"These suede sandals in sand tone are chosen specifically to match the skin/leg line under the midi hem, avoiding a harsh break at the ankle and maintaining the vertical illusion requested for the silhouette.","finding":"f-o6-3"}]}],"needed":[{"kind":"shoes","description":"A pair of black leather loafers or pumps to complete outfit o1 and replace the brown suede option which breaks the tonal column too abruptly in an office setting.","type":"loafers","color":"black","fabric":"leather"},{"kind":"headwear","description":"A simple gold headband for outfit o6 to add a small focal point near the face, balancing the dark tones of the blouse and skirt without adding heavy jewelry.","type":"headband","color":"golden","fabric":"unknown"}]}
